pages.title: Transcendent Plasma Forge
pages.text: Four plasma injectors fire into a coil-wrapped chamber hotter than a hypernova. Burns catalyst plasmas to forge metals whose properties are chosen rather than discovered.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 6$() machine.

A hypernova is the death of a star so massive its explosion outshines an ordinary supernova many times over. This chamber runs hotter.$(br2)This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.

First firing. It has to be bootstrapped with $(fluid)Residual Starlight$(), made from a Stellar Core. Every forging after that burns a catalyst plasma and leaves $(fluid)Dimensional Residue$() behind.

Coil tier sets what it can forge:$(li)tier 3: Hypernova Alloy$(li)tier 4: Hypernova Plasma$(li)tier 5 (Transfinite Coils): Transcendent Metal$(br2)Note to self: upgrade the coils before ordering the plasma, not after.

pages.name: Transcendent Plasma Forge
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Apeiron Ingot, Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Dimensional Residue, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Hypernova Plasma, Omnipotence Casing, Residual Starlight, Transcendent Glass, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma, Transcendent Stone.
$(fluid)Residual Starlight$(). Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br)Used for: Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Cosmic String Segment, Dark Energy, Dimensional Residue, Distillate of Spacetime.
$(fluid)Dimensional Residue$(). Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br)Used for: Chronon Gas, Dark Matter, Dimensional Singularity, Exotic Matter, Inflaton Field.
